about.text: A soft cow's-milk cheese named after the Brie region around Seine-et-Marne, with a white mould rind that is typically eaten. Rennet is added to raw milk warmed to at most 37 °C, and the curd is cast into moulds, sometimes with a perforated ladle called a pelle à brie.

sources.text: Soft cow's milk, rennet at up to 37 °C and the pelle à brie.
